data.long_meaning: The name Bhuvnesh is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Bhuv' means 'Lord' and 'Nesh' means 'Creation'. It signifies the one who is the lord of creation and is revered in Hindu mythology. The name Bhuvnesh carries the meaning “Lord of creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhuvnesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
